title: Vivumishi Viashiria (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses the demonstrative by the noun's class, number and distance (huyu/yule, hiki/kile, haya/yale).
representations: a table of demonstratives by class
steps: Find the noun and its class.

board.do: Point at the heart picture close by.
board.say: Kiashiria cha U-I karibu ni kipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "moyo huu" and "mioyo hii".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Vitabu ___ ni vya maktaba." Kwa nini "hiki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kiashiria hubadilika kulingana na idadi: kitabu hiki, vitabu hivi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mawe ___ ni mazito." Kwa nini "hivi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kiashiria huchukua ngeli ya nomino. Mawe ni ya LI-YA, kwa hiyo haya.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto ___ aliye mbali na sisi ni mdogo wangu." Kwa nini "huyu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kilicho karibu huonyeshwa kwa huyu, hiki; kilicho mbali kwa yule, kile.

misconceptions.ask: Kiswahili huweka kiashiria kabla au baada ya nomino kwa kawaida?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa kawaida kiashiria hufuata nomino: kitabu hiki.
